description.text: One of the two BW8 expansions released together on 14 December 2012, with the mythical Deoxys on the wrapper. The two packs build up the Team Plasma cards begun in Plasma Gale: Deoxys, Thundurus and Tornadus in Therian Forme, and every evolution of Eevee appear as Team Plasma Pokémon, and the once hard-to-get Team Plasma Ball came back. Spiral Force's Pokémon-EX are Deoxys-EX, Heatran-EX and Latios-EX. The cards are numbered to 51. In English most of its cards came out in Plasma Freeze in May 2013.
